findings.summary: Worker claim lifecycle is implemented in onComplete rather than as fenced source job work
findings.details: The approved implementation requires a source worker to claim by lease/CAS, heartbeat, persist external response hashes before commit, then complete under pinned generation/effect fencing. Here backgroundWork is a no-op and onComplete performs claim/response/success after the workpool action has already completed, which leaves no fenced lease protecting external work or before-ACK replay semantics.
